units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:5:3">Y. Ber. II, 5ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>טַרְחוּתָם מרובה</he> the trouble of climbing them down is very great. Pesik. Bayom, p. 193ᵃ <he>ט׳ הדרכים</he> the trouble of travelling.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:6:3">Cant. R. to VIII, 6</cite> <he>שהגשמים … סימן טיר׳</he> for there are those rains which betoken trouble &c.—Pesik. R. s. 34</cite> <he>אין הק״בה בא בט׳ וכ׳</he> the Lord comes not with burdensome laws to be imposed upon &c.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 1:8">Lev. R. s. 1</cite> <he>משה עסוק בט׳ וכ׳</he> Moses occupied himself with arranging the living of Israel (ordaining dietary laws).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94:5">Gen. R. s. 94</cite> <he>ט׳ נפש אחת</he> provision for one soul.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 3:1">Pesik. R. s. 3</cite> (ref. to <he>מתה עלי</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 48:7">Gen. XLVIII, 7</cite>) <he>עלי היתה טַרְחוּתָהּ</he> mine was the care for her.
